```python
import hamana

hamana.connect()

# Create test data
hamana.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)")
hamana.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 'Alice')")
hamana.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (2, 'Bob')")

# Wrap the SQL string in hamana's Query object
query = hamana.Query("SELECT id, name FROM users")

# Execute it against the library's internal database
hamana.execute(query)

# Read the query's results back as the resulting pandas DataFrame
df = query.result

hamana.disconnect()

print(df)
```
